question: What claim is being made about the capacity of even a wise person when burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence?
premises: A location is indicated at the tip of nectar.
An instrument is indicated by the tip of essence.
A wise person is described as burning, even so.
inference: Even a wise person, under the condition of burning at those points, is brought into consideration by this statement.
uncertainties: The outcome for the wise person is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise person, though burning, remains.
